**What this pass establishes (author side, not a review)**
- All 11 C04 chapters were audited in full. Their initial hashes matched the inventory.
- **Gap repaired:** the hypothesis `(eq:word-motion-input)` of `prop:word-motion` was never discharged in the draft. That hypothesis is Poincaré invariance of the word kernel plus continuity of g↦K(b,gc). The source proves it as `YM.Work.C28.answer`, which is absent from `reconstruction-evidence.md`. The new `cor:word-motion-inputs` in `boundary-detection.tex` proves it, following C28 (`rev_po`, `gpush_split`/`expect_po`, `strong`/`continuous_pinned`).
- **New same-data edge `C03-C14-to-C04-involution-identity`:** the J in `input:calibrated-actions` must be the reflected conjugate of `reflection.tex`. θκ commutes with K_a=-iL_a, while κ alone anticommutes. In Lean this identification is `starRead J h`.
- **Notation:** the isometry H→H_E is now 𝒱, distinct from the time group V. Reconstruction now uses T_E for the joint Euclidean translations, and h_t(τ_a b) replaces h_t(ab).
- No other substantive defect was found. Per-chapter results: [findings.md](https://github.com/ADB991/humanise-yang-mills/blob/claude/issue-45-5b03/blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C04/findings.md).

Producers need to acknowledge the exact statements.
- There was no Lean elaboration (Mathlib is blocked here), so the correspondence rests on text reads only. The cited literature was not re-inspected.
- For G03: the Williams citation reads Thm 2.19 in the text but Thm 2.13, pp. 29–31 in the bibitem. For G06: label detection does not actually need the Lorentz input (see O2). For G01: the endpoint needs to say whether it uses `UniqueHeat` (O3).
